subject.title: fix(telegram): prefer current replied photo media

question: Should this PR wait for current-head live Telegram reply-photo proof before merge, or should maintainers explicitly accept synthetic-only evidence for this reply-context change?
rationale: The scoped Telegram guide and external PR proof gate require real behavior proof for reply-context changes, but only a maintainer can choose to override that gap.

options.title: Require live Telegram proof
options.body: Keep the PR open until the contributor or Mantis provides redacted Telegram Desktop, bot-to-bot transcript, terminal output, or runtime logs for the after-fix path.

options.title: Accept synthetic-only proof
options.body: Merge after code review while explicitly owning that the real Telegram transport path was not proven on the current head.

options.title: Pause for maintainer proof
options.body: Leave the PR idle until a maintainer can run the Telegram proof lane and update the review with current-head evidence.

recommendation.title: Require live Telegram proof
recommendation.body: Keep the PR open until the contributor or Mantis provides redacted Telegram Desktop, bot-to-bot transcript, terminal output, or runtime logs for the after-fix path.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the strongest history owner for the current-turn native image pipeline that this PR changes.
